entries.def:
πτῶσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίπτω), [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶף, מַפֶּלֶת, and cogn. forms ;] 
a falling, fall (Plat., Plut., al.): Mat.7.27 metaphorically, Luk.2.34.†
(AS)

πτωχεία, -ας, ἡ
(πτωχεύω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] 
beggary, destitution: 2Co.8.2; 8.9, Rev.2.9.†
(AS)

πτωχεύω
(πτωχός), [in LXX: Jdg.6.6, Psa.79.8 (דָּלַל); Jdg.14.15 A, Pro.23.21 (יָרַשׁ); Psa.34.10 (רוּשׁ), Tob.4.21 * ;] 
__1. to be a beggar, to beg (so chiefly in cl.). 
__2. to be poor as a beggar, to be destitute, poor: opposite to πλούσιος ὤν, 2Co.8.9.†
(AS)

πτωχός, -ή, -όν
(πτώσσω, to crouch, cower), [in LXX for עָנִי, דַּל, רָשׁ, etc. ;] 
of one who crouches and cowers, hence, 
__1. as subst., a beggar: Luk.14.13, 21; 16.20, 22. 
__2. As adj., 
__(a) prop., beggarly: metaphorically, στοιχεῖα, Gal.4.9 (see Lft., in l); 
__(b) in broader sense (opposite to πλούσιος), poor: Mat.11.5; 19.21; 26.9, 11, Mrk.10.21; 12.42-43; 14.5, 7, Luk.4.18; 7.22; 18.22; 19.8; 21.3,…

πυγμή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Exo.21.18, Isa.58.4 (אֶגְרֹף) * ;] 
the fist: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χῖρας (Τ, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), to wash the hands with the fist (diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; see Swete, in l): Mrk.7.3.†
(AS)

πύθων, -ωνος, ὁ 
__1. in cl., Python, a serpent slain by Apollo, who is hence surnamed the Pythian. 
__2. In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. Lev.19.31; 20.6, 27, 1Sa.28.7), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, a python-spirit: Act.16.16.†
(AS)

πυκιός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Ezk.31.3 A (חֹרֶשׁ), 3Ma.1.28 3Mac.4.10, 4Ma.12.12 * ;] 
__1. close, compact, solid. 
__2. frequent: 1Ti.5.23. Neut. pl., πυκνά, as adv., much, often: Mrk.7.3 Τ (see: πυγμή), Luk.5.33. Comparat., πυκνότερον, very often or so much the oftener (seeBl., § 44, 3,): Act.24.26.†
(AS)

πύλη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח ;] 
a gate: Luk.7.12, Act.9.24; 12.10; 16.13, Heb.13.12; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, Act.3.10. Metaphorical, Mat.7.13-14; πύλαι ᾅδου (Wis.16.13, 3Ma.5.51, and cf. κλαῖς ᾅδου Rev.1.18): Mat.16.18.†
(AS)
